request.system: You are a presentation designer who lays out funder decks slide by slide, the way a strong designer writing python-pptx code would: each slide's layout chosen for what it says.
request.input_head:
This slide was measured in the brand's real fonts and has problems:
- element 3 (figure) does not fit its 430 x 104 box even at the smallest type size

Each slide is positioned elements on a 960 x 540 canvas (points, origin top left). Element types:
- text: {"type":"text","x","y","w","h","text","style","color","align"}  style: title | heading | figure | body | strong | italic | small | label
- list: {"type":"list","x","y","w","h","items":["..."],"style":"body"}  bulleted points
- rect: {"type":"rect","x","y","w","h","fill"}  a panel or band (draw it BEFORE the text that sits on it)
- line: {"type":"line","x","y","w","h","color"}  a rule (h 2 for horizontal, w 2 for vertical)
- dot: {"type":"dot","x","y","w","h","fill"}  a circle (timeline markers)
- figure: {"type":"figure","x","y","w","h","value":"$31,900","label":"vehicle costs in FY2026","note":"up from $19,700","fill":"tint"}  a big-number tile (omit fill for no panel)
- bars: {"type":"bars","x","y","w","h","orient":"horizontal"|"vertical","items":[{"label","value","highlight":true}]}  a bar or column chart; value is the number as shown ("$85,000", "41%")
- stack: {"type":"stack","x","y","w","h","items":[{"label","value","highlight"}]}  one bar split into its parts (funding sources)
- table: {"type":"table","x","y","w","h","header":["Line","Amount"],"rows":[["Van","$74,000"]],"total":["Total","$148,000"]}
- quote: {"type":"quote","x","y","w","h","text","who"}
- callout: {"type":"callout","x","y","w","h","title","text" or

response.title: 14 of 19 graduates (74%) were working at 90 days, from a small, partly self-reported group

els.text: 14 of 19 graduates (74%) were working at 90 days, from a small, partly self-reported group
Employment After 90 Days: where the 14 were hired

items.label: Bike shops or bike rental and fleet operators in the county
Related mechanical trades: small-engine, appliance repair, forklift maintenance

els.title: Caveats on this number
items: This is a small group. One graduate moves the rate by about five points
7 of the 14 placements were confirmed by an employer. The other 7 are self-reported by the graduate
We do not have one-year retention data for FY2026 graduates yet
FY2025 one-year check: 7 of the 8 employed at 90 days were still working. That is one cohort of 12, not a trend yet

els.text: Starting in FY2027, we will ask every graduate for employer contact consent at graduation
